CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (cell set), an explicit organization/presentation statement and a separate origin/status field are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to a specific content's presentation or access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content-item entries identify colored cell sets (content) with attributes (red/blue) and node referents.

D.rationale: Content cell sets are repeatedly presented alongside separate origin/status fields, distinguishing identification from provenance/status.

O.rationale: The report explicitly describes how contents are presented/organized (layout rule and explicit cell-set presentations), including candidate (represented_time later) entries.
